name: Quickfire Imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, lean and twitchy, orange-hot skin, an ember in each hand, grinning manically, wings beating very fast

poses.stand: hovering forward-leaning on fast-beating wings, an ember ready in each hand
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers twitchily, bouncing in the air, tossing its embers

attack.action: rapidly flings an ember from one hand then the other forward to the right, quick as a jab

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
